app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The user-service Deployment is configured with nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node but there is no node with that hostname in the cluster, so the user-service Pod cannot be scheduled (Pod remains Pending). Concretely: Deployment spec contains Node-Selectors: kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node and the Pod's Events show FailedScheduling: "0/2 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector, 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }."

args.root_cause: The user-service Deployment is configured with nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node but there is no node with that hostname in the cluster, so the user-service Pod cannot be scheduled (Pod remains Pending). Concretely: Deployment spec contains Node-Selectors: kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node and the Pod's Events show FailedScheduling: "0/2 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector, 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }."
args.evidence_summary:
1) kubectl get pods (namespace=test-social-network) showed user-service-5b549cc8dc-cwg8g in Status: Pending while other services are Running.
2) kubectl describe pod user-service-5b549cc8dc-cwg8g showed Conditions: PodScheduled False and Events with FailedScheduling: "0/2 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector, 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }."
3) kubectl get nodes returned only two nodes: kind-control-plane and kind-worker (no node named extra-node).
4) kubectl describe deployment user-service showed Pod Template Node-Selectors: kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node and that 1 desired replica is unavailable (Deployment cannot make the pod available).
args.investigation_summary: I listed pods in the test-social-network namespace and noticed one pod (user-service-5b549cc8dc-cwg8g) Pending. I described that pod to see scheduling events which indicated a node selector/taint scheduling failure. I checked cluster nodes and found no node named extra-node. I described the user-service Deployment and confirmed it sets nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node, causing the pod to remain Pending and the Deployment to have 0 available replicas.
